sections.heading: The pattern travels; air oscillates locally
sections.body: Ordinary sound in air is a longitudinal pressure wave. Frequency times wavelength equals wave speed.
sections.visual: The speaker moves back and forth. Air particles oscillate around their own positions. Follow one particle: it does not travel across the diagram.

sections.heading: Three different questions about a note
sections.body: Pitch tracks fundamental frequency. Loudness tracks amplitude. Timbre tracks spectrum shape and envelope.
sections.visual: Pitch, amplitude and timbre answer different questions about the same note. Harmonic bars show spectral shape.
sections.diagram: <svg viewBox="0 0 800 400" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="img" aria-label="Three different questions about a note"><title>Three different questions about a note</title><rect x="0" y="0" width="800" height="400" rx="16" fill="#101923"/><text x="28" y="35" fill="#e8ecf1" font-size="21" font-family="sans-serif">Three different questions about a note</text><path d="M28 51 L772 51" fill="none" stroke="#344253" stroke-width="2"/><text x="80" y="100" fill="#9aa6b8" font-size="16">Harmonic spectrum</text><rect class="lw-bar" x="100" y="140" width="36" height="160" fill="#7cc7ff" rx="4"/><rect class="lw-bar" x="160" y="180" width="36" height="120" fill="#7ee2a8" rx="4"/><rect class="lw-bar" x="220" y="200" width="36" height="100" fill="#ffd479" rx="4"/><rect class="lw-bar" x="280" y="230" width="36" height="70" fill="#b39dff" rx="4"/><rect class="lw-bar" x="340" y="250" width="36" height="50" fill="#7cc7ff" rx="4"/><g class="lw-step"><text x="500" y="150" fill="#7cc7ff" font-size="18">Pitch → fundamental</text></g><g class="lw-step"><text x="500" y="200" fill="#7ee2a8" font-size="18">Loudness → amplitude</text></g><g class="lw-step"><text x="500" y="250" fill="#ffd479" font-size="18">Timbre → spectrum shape</text></g><path d="M28 350 L772 350" fill="none" stroke="#344253" stroke-width="2"/><text x="28" y="379" fill="#9aa6b8" font-size="15">Same pitch can still sound different</text></svg>

sections.heading: Boundaries select a standing pattern
sections.body: For a string fixed at both ends, ends are nodes. Fundamental frequency is wave speed over twice the length.
sections.visual: Nodes stay still; antinodes move most. Scrub through the standing-wave cycle.
